step-1.scope: Windows payloads when the policy denies their signer or hash. A valid signature alone does not establish that an app is approved.

step-2.note: Review the delivery chain and program provenance. Code style or apparent AI functionality does not establish maliciousness or AI authorship.

step-4.note: Investigate browser-store reads, token use and egress; investigate security-tool changes separately with product-specific logs.
